stories.title: Jensen Huang built Nvidia into a behemoth. His scandal puts the entire AI boom in jeopardy.
stories.summary: Huang fueled his company and the AI ecosystem with advanced chips and creative financing deals across the supply chain. What happens if he’s gone?
stories.zh_title: 黃仁勳將 Nvidia 打造成一個龐然大物。他的醜聞使整個人工智慧熱潮陷入危險之中。
stories.zh_summary: 黃仁勳透過整個供應鏈的先進晶片和創意融資交易為他的公司和人工智慧生態系統提供了動力。如果他走了怎麼辦？

stories.title: Jensen Huang's affair with alleged spy revives push to tighten China chip curbs ahead of Trump-Xi summit
stories.summary: The scandal engulfing Jensen Huang is fueling calls for tighter restrictions on China's access to advanced AI chips, just days before the Trump-Xi summit.
stories.zh_title: 黃仁勳與涉嫌間諜的戀情再次推動川普與習近平峰會前加強對中國晶片的限制
stories.zh_summary: 就在特習峰會召開前幾天，黃仁勳的醜聞引發了對中國獲取先進人工智慧晶片實施更嚴格限制的呼聲。

stories.title: Falling oil prices are no longer enough to bring down borrowing costs in the world’s most important bond market
stories.summary: The tight trading relationship between oil prices and Treasury yields has broken down. It’s a sign that inflation concerns are extending beyond the energy shock.
stories.zh_title: 油價下跌已不足以降低全球最重要債券市場的借貸成本
stories.zh_summary: 油價與國債殖利率之間的緊密交易關係已經破裂。這表明通膨擔憂已經超出了能源衝擊的範圍。

stories.title: Taiwan’s chipmaking giant TSMC to invest $1B in Anthropic, OpenAI
stories.summary: Latest example of the AI boom’s circular financing comes as AI trade wobbles.
stories.zh_title: 台灣晶片製造大廠台積電將向 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 投資 10 億美元
stories.zh_summary: 人工智慧熱潮循環融資的最新例子是在人工智慧貿易動盪之際出現的。

stories.title: Google’s AlphaGenome 2 zooms in on the cellular roots of disease
stories.summary: Researchers at Google DeepMind have unveiled a new AI model designed to unravel how changes in our DNA affect different cells, giving scientists a more detailed view of a notoriously difficult problem that could hold important clues to the causes of disease - and point the way to new treatments. AlphaGenome 2 is the successor […]
stories.zh_title: 谷歌的 AlphaGenome 2 聚焦疾病的細胞根源
stories.zh_summary: Google DeepMind 的研究人員推出了一種新的人工智慧模型，旨在揭示我們 DNA 的變化如何影響不同的細胞，讓科學家更詳細地了解一個臭名昭著的難題，該問題可能為疾病原因提供重要線索，並為新的治療方法指明道路。阿爾普

stories.title: A Startup Wants to Fight AI Bioweapons With AI
stories.summary: Radical Numerics has developed a model that it says can identify natural and AI-engineered pathogens without an internet connection.
stories.zh_title: 一家新創公司希望用人工智慧對抗人工智慧生物武器
stories.zh_summary: Radical Numerics 開發了一種模型，據稱可以在沒有網路連線的情況下識別自然和人工智慧工程的病原體。

stories.title: Google DeepMind just mathematically verified key parts of Signal
stories.summary: The four-week project hints that AI could make formal verification far more practical.
stories.zh_title: Google DeepMind 剛剛從數學上驗證了 Signal 的關鍵部分
stories.zh_summary: 這個為期四週的計畫暗示人工智慧可以使形式驗證更加實用。

stories.title: Nasdaq futures fall as Nvidia sinks 8% after hours on report board may oust Huang
stories.summary: Stock futures were sliding Wednesday evening as a selloff in shares of Nvidia after the closing bell weighed on the Nasdaq-100 and dragged down shares of other chip makers.
stories.zh_title: 納斯達剋期貨下跌，英偉達盤後下跌 8%，因董事會可能罷免黃仁勳
stories.zh_summary: 週三晚間，由於英偉達股票在收盤後遭到拋售，納斯達克 100 指數承壓，並拖累其他晶片製造商的股價下跌，股票期貨下跌。

stories.title: Meta head of infrastructure will leave and be succeeded by former AWS cloud exec
stories.summary: Meta's head of infrastructure and co-head of engineering Santosh Janardhan will leave in 2027, with former AWS senior vice president David Brown taking over.
stories.zh_title: Meta 基礎設施負責人將離職，由前 AWS 雲端主管接任
stories.zh_summary: Meta 的基礎設施主管兼工程聯席主管 Santosh Janardhan 將於 2027 年離職，由前 AWS 高級副總裁 David Brown 接任。

stories.title: Why this ‘big idea’ to fix Social Security relies on a massive stock-market gamble
stories.summary: From a long-term perspective, the past 50 years of strong market gains are the exception rather than the rule
stories.zh_title: 為什麼這個解決社會安全問題的「偉大想法」依賴一場大規模的股市賭博
stories.zh_summary: 從長遠來看，過去50年的強勁市場成長只是例外而不是規則

stories.title: Fed's Goolsbee calls inflation report 'borderline disturbing' as central bank weighs more hikes
stories.summary: The consumer price index rose more than expected in October, raising alarm among Federal Reserve officials.
stories.zh_title: 聯準會古爾斯比稱通膨報告“令人不安”，央行考慮進一步升息
stories.zh_summary: 10月消費者物價指數漲幅超乎預期，引起聯準會官員的警覺。

stories.title: Nvidia’s stock drops as the board reportedly prepares to remove CEO Jensen Huang
stories.summary: Nvidia’s board of directors reportedly could meet as soon as today to determine the CEO’s fate.
stories.zh_title: 據報道，英偉達董事會準備罷免執行長黃仁勳，股價下跌
stories.zh_summary: 據報道，英偉達董事會最快可能在今天召開會議，決定執行長的命運。

stories.title: Nvidia prepares to oust Jensen Huang, WSJ reports — stock sinks
stories.summary: The report comes days after Huang admitted to an affair with a woman who is believed by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy.
stories.zh_title: 根據《華爾街日報》報道，英偉達準備罷免黃仁勳－股價下跌
stories.zh_summary: 幾天前，黃承認與一名被美國情報部門認為是中國間諜的女子有染。
